title: Expiry is mandatory on issuance
description: Engineering consequence of QR Code Generation, 4. Step 3 — Build the CWT claim set; HCERT Specification, 6.1 HCERT Signature Validity Time. QR Code Generation, 4. Step 3 — Build the CWT claim set: “exp is the only revocation mechanism this specification offers”.

statements.label: Expiry is mandatory on issuance
statements.requirement: The issuer API SHALL require an explicit validity (exp, or a validity period) and SHALL have no default of "never expires". exp is the only revocation mechanism.

successCriteria.criterion: A test named after STT-CWT-003 passes in each implementation's suite (Kotlin: `STT-CWT-003 an HCERT without exp is refused on issue and on verify` (BuildCwtTest.kt)).
